summary: Frontend-only testing of new one-tap Prompt Presets feature across all 4 studios (Image /create, Video /video, Music /audio, 3D /3d). Verified preset rows render, every preset chip populates the correct prompt textarea with a non-empty descriptive prompt, matching style chips are highlighted where applicable, prompt remains editable, and Generate button is enabled. Generations were NOT submitted per instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: PresetRow is clean, DRY, and reused across 4 pages — good implementation.
data-testid coverage is complete for all preset buttons and rows as specified.
test_credentials: None required — all 4 studios usable without login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preset feature verified via DOM input.value reads (not screenshots) as advised. Testing covered: 6 image presets fill #prompt-input and highlight image style button (Portrait->Photorealistic active); 6 video presets fill #video-prompt-input; 5 music presets fill #music-prompt-input, Jazz additionally activates music-style-jazz chip (confirmed active class bg-[#00F0FF]); 6 3D presets fill #model-prompt-input in text mode. Prompt text editable post-fill (appended ' EDITED' successfully); Generate button not disabled.
